name: Two-panel points game (about 20 minutes)
description:
This study investigates how people adjust their choices when the payoffs of two options change over time.

You will play a game in which you click one of two panels to earn points. How often each panel pays changes during the game without warning, and occasionally a panel is marked to show it will pay especially well, or that clicking it will cost a point.

The task needs a desktop or laptop computer. There are no known risks beyond those of everyday computer use; you may experience mild boredom or fatigue. Full consent information is shown before the task begins.
